Every KG node carries a source_record_id because the graph is a *fusion* of two dashboards (Well-Connectivity + Water-Management) built by deterministic ETL/rules — the field records the provenance of each node back to the exact upstream record (or rule) it was derived from. For example, the Alert node A_WCT_SEVERE_F-12_2013-03-01 has source_record_id "rule:WCT_SEVERE:R_water_cut_F-12_2013-03-01", pointing to the rule and the raw water_cut reading that triggered it. This matters for citation validation because: (1) it makes every node's lineage auditable and reproducible (the generator_seed=42 makes derivation deterministic); (2) it lets a validator confirm that a cited node id actually resolves to a real, traceable source rather than a fabricated identifier; and (3) it ties analyst claims to verifiable evidence, so citations can be checked against genuine upstream data instead of being taken on trust.

The recommended water_shutoff interventions are all driven by rising water_cut diagnostics. Each intervention is RECOMMENDED_FOR a water-management Alert, and each Alert is TRIGGERED_BY a water_cut MetricReading. Two diagnostic patterns cause them: (1) WCT_SEVERE alerts — a severe/high water cut (the F-12 and F-14 shutoffs), and (2) a WATER_BREAKTHROUGH alert — a sudden water-cut breakthrough (the F-15 D shutoff, where water_cut jumped from ~0.076 in Jul-2015 to ~0.34 in Aug-2015 and exceeded 0.5 by Dec-2015). So the root cause is a high/severe or breakthrough water cut measured on the producer.

The three entities form a chain around a single Alert node. (1) A MetricReading (e.g. R_water_cut_F-12_2013-03-01, itself MEASURED_BY a sensor S_water_cut_F-12) crosses a rule threshold and the Alert points to it via the Alert→MetricReading edge TRIGGERED_BY (also mirrored in the Alert's source_record_id = "rule:WCT_SEVERE:..."). (2) The Alert (e.g. A_WCT_SEVERE_F-12_2013-03-01, with alert_code/severity/well/raised_at) is the hub. (3) An Intervention (e.g. I_WCT_SEVERE_F-12_2013-03-01) attaches to the Alert via the Intervention→Alert edge RECOMMENDED_FOR, and its outcome is traced forward to a later reading via FOLLOWED_BY. So: MetricReading —TRIGGERED_BY← Alert ←RECOMMENDED_FOR— Intervention —FOLLOWED_BY→ result reading.
